items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: The band was just about six musicians... The trumpet player was the leader. His name Cohen... I don't know whether he was Cuban or Puerto Rican.

ctx.x: So it was basically a dance band that you were...

No. The band was just about six musicians, that's all, sitting up there. And they were so lazy... The trumpet player was the leader. His name Cohen(?), and he was Puerto Rican or Cuban... I don't know whether he was Cuban or Puerto Rican. But usually they're pretty ambitious people, but he was a lazy one. He could play, but he didn't want to play. He wasn't interested in nothin'. Just "Let's get the night over with." That's all he wanted. And get away from there.

There were a couple of others in the band... They didn't care nothin' about music. It was just a job, that's all. The piano player, he was a good piano player, but stayed drunk all the time. He drank all the time. But he was a good piano player. And he wanted to always talk, and he'd be slobberin' and carryin' on, and couldn't nobody understand what he was saying. "Yah, bah-bah," he was talkin' all over the place.
